message: this operation always traps: its divisor is the literal 0
label: always traps
notes: division and remainder by zero trap with status 72 on every run, so the trap is part of what this expression means
help: divide by a value that can be nonzero, or handle the zero case first

message: this `vecGet` always traps: its index is a negative literal
label: always traps
notes: `vecGet` traps with status 77 on an index outside the vector, and a negative index is outside every vector
help: index with a value from 0 to the vector's length

message: this value always traps: the literal 200 is outside the range of `Percent`
label: always traps
notes: a value outside a subtype's range traps with status 80 on every run, so the trap is part of what this call means
help: pass a value inside the subtype's range
